messages:
Zara: Thinking of a Saturday midday thing: Build-your-own bagel board + "mystery mimosas" (non-alc options too) + silent disco from 12-2. Tiny, optional, BYO headphones ok. Anyone game?
Ethan: Very in. Ill bring a small speaker (just in case) and some shmear ideas. :bagel:
Priya Rao: Love it. Mystery mimosas = fun. I can do a non-alc sparkling citrus batch.
Marco: Silent disco rules: bring headphones or borrow from music-bot. I'll bring a few extra sets. Also can run a 15m playlist swap game.
Jules: Can we add a gluten-free bagel option? Also would love a coffee corner.
Zara: Yes GF option for sure. Coffee corner noted. Plan: 11:45 setup, 12:00 start, 14:00 wrap. RSVP in-thread with "Yes/Maybe/No + headcount + food contrib"
Ethan: Yes / 1 / everything bagel + lox-ish (vegan lox for one).
Priya Rao: Yes / 2 / citrus mock-mimosas + orange slices.
Marco: Maybe / 2 / extra headphones and aux speaker.
Jules: Yes / 1 / GF bagels + almond butter (no nuts for one guest? actually they can have almond).
music-bot: Headphone inventory: 6 sets available for short-term borrow. Please wash before return.
Zara: I'll reserve the rooftop kitchenette (alt: Lounge) and drop a calendar invite after we confirm headcount. @facilities any rooftop rules?
calendar-bot: Event created	"Mystery Brunch & Silent Disco"	Sat 2025-09-20 12:00	Location: Rooftop Kitchenette (alt: Lounge). RSVP in thread.
Marco: Quick note: if it's windy we'll move to the Lounge. Zara can you post a weather check poll tomorrow?
Zara: Will do  also volunteers for setup/cleanup? 15m each.
Ethan: I can do setup (arrange board, coffee).
Priya Rao: I'll help cleanup.
Jules: I'll bring labels for any allergens and utensils.
Zara: Sweet. If anyone wants to DJ a silent set, drop a 30-sec sample or playlist link. :headphones:
Priya Rao: I have a bubbly brunch playlist I'll add.
Marco: Noted. See y'all Saturday if poll looks good!
